items.title: THE AVOS
items.quote: Give [homage] to Hashem, O you sons of the mighty. Give [homage] to Hashem [for His] glory and might.
items.text: Give public honor to the Creator, calling upon the kedushah achieved by our Avos.

items.quote: Give [homage] to Hashem [for] the honor of His Name. Bow down to Hashem [for] the splendor of [His] holiness.

items.title: THUNDERING
items.quote: The voice of Hashem is over the waters. The G-d of glory is thundering, Hashem is over the mighty waters.
items.text: When you hear the sound of thunder you are hearing the voice of Hashem.

items.title: LIGHTNING
items.quote: The voice of Hashem carves out flames of fire.
items.text: When you see the flash and hear the crack of lightning you are witnessing the power of Hashem.

items.title: HARMONY OF PEACE
items.quote: Hashem is giving the strength [of the Torah] to His nation and Hashem will bless His nation with peace.
items.text: Look to the Torah to appreciate the grandeur of Hashem. The harmonious relationships among all the parts of the Torah and among all the parts of the natural world correspond to the blessing of peace which Hashem offers to Yisrael.
